articles.title: How Beijing 'tripled the size of its nuclear arsenal' in six years
articles.summary: China recently launched an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) carrying a dummy warhead into the Pacific, alarming nations globally. This demonstration of advanced military capability has heightened regional and international concerns about strategic stability. The incident prompts a reassessment of defence strategies and diplomatic responses to China's growing military assertiveness in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: India is a long-term bet: PM Modi to Australian CEOs
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi urged Australian businesses to consider India a prime long-term investment destination. He called for the swift conclusion of the proposed bilateral Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA), highlighting India's robust economic growth and market potential. This initiative aims to strengthen economic ties and boost trade between India and Australia, fostering mutual prosperity and strategic partnership critical for regional stability.

articles.title: BJP hails BrahMos deal during PM Modi's tour; Congress talks LAC
articles.summary: The BJP has hailed Prime Minister Modi's three-nation diplomatic tour as a major strategic success, emphasizing the proposed 5,400-crore BrahMos missile deal. This significant agreement is expected to boost India's defence manufacturing and exports, strengthening strategic partnerships. It underscores India's growing global influence and self-reliance in advanced defence technology.

articles.title: Joanna Pettet Dead: 'The Group,' 'Casino Royale' Actress Was 83
articles.summary: Joanna Pettet, the London-born actress known for roles in Sidney Lumet’s "The Group" and as a spy opposite David Niven’s James Bond in "Casino Royale," has passed away. Her career encompassed significant film and television appearances, establishing her as a recognized figure in the acting world. She was acclaimed for her versatile performances across various genres, leaving a notable legacy.

articles.title: US' pointing fingers at China's missile test 'double standards': FM
articles.summary: China recently conducted a test launch of a strategic missile from a submarine, a move that has drawn swift international reactions. Countries including the United States and Australia have voiced concerns following this significant development in regional military capabilities. This event underscores rising geopolitical tensions related to naval power and strategic deterrence in the Indo-Pacific.
